<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style id="mr-host-theme">:root{color-scheme:dark;--mr-bg:#131316;--mr-surface:#1b1b1f;--mr-surface-raised:#252932;--mr-border:rgba(255,255,255,0.11);--mr-text:#eef0f4;--mr-text-muted:#9aa3b2;--mr-radius:12px}html,body{background:var(--mr-bg) !important;color:var(--mr-text);min-height:100%}body{padding:14px !important;box-sizing:border-box}</style>

<script>
(function(){
  if (window.mindroom) return;
  let toast;
  function showToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) {
      toast = document.createElement('div');
      toast.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#1f232d;color:#f2f4f8;border:1px solid #45b5c9;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:99999;max-width:90vw;text-align:center;';
      document.body.appendChild(toast);
    }
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.style.opacity = '1';
    clearTimeout(toast._t);
    toast._t = setTimeout(() => { toast.style.opacity = '0'; }, 3500);
  }
  window.mindroom = {
    colorScheme: 'dark',
    saveState() {},
    submit(data, opts) {
      const label = (opts && opts.label) || 'your choice';
      showToast('In MindRoom Chat, this sends "' + label + '" straight back to the agent.');
    },
  };
  document.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.target;
    const label = (form && form.getAttribute && form.getAttribute('data-mindroom-label')) || 'your choice';
    window.mindroom.submit({}, { label });
  });
})();
</script>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>MindRoom Apple Watch — UI Redesign Mockups</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: var(--mr-bg, #121418);
    --surface: var(--mr-surface, #1a1d24);
    --surface-raised: var(--mr-surface-raised, #232732);
    --border: var(--mr-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.10));
    --text: var(--mr-text, #f2f4f8);
    --muted: var(--mr-text-muted, #9aa3b2);
    --accent: var(--mr-accent, #45b5c9);
    --accent-text: var(--mr-accent-text, #061419);
    --radius: var(--mr-radius, 12px);
    --font: var(--mr-font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Rounded", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif);
    --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;

    /* MindRoom icon palette */
    --teal: #45b5c9;
    --teal-bright: #70d2e3;
    --teal-deep: #133c4b;
    --amber: #f5b952;
    --amber-warm: #ffcf75;
    --today-purple: #7860e0;
    --apple-red: #ff453a;
    --apple-green: #32d74b;
    --apple-orange: #ff9f0a;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: var(--font);
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.4;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  .wrap {
    max-width: 1020px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  /* Top control bar */
  .controls-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }

  .seg-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
    background: var(--surface-raised);
    padding: 3px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .seg-btn {
    appearance: none;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--muted);
    font: 600 12px/1 var(--font);
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease;
  }
  .seg-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .seg-btn[aria-pressed="true"] {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-text);
  }

  .state-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .state-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--muted);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* Shared baseline note */
  .shared-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 9px 12px;
  }
  .shared-note strong { color: var(--text); }

  /* 4-watch comparison grid */
  .watch-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: start;
  }
  @media (max-width: 920px) {
    .watch-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  }
  @media (max-width: 500px) {
    .watch-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

  .variant-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px 10px 14px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .variant-col.recommended {
    border-color: rgba(69, 181, 201, 0.55);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(69, 181, 201, 0.22) inset;
  }

  .variant-head {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 66px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
  .variant-title-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
  }
  .variant-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .rec-pill {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(69, 181, 201, 0.2);
    color: #70d2e3;
    border: 1px solid rgba(69, 181, 201, 0.4);
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .today-pill {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    color: var(--muted);
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .variant-sub {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  /* Apple Watch 46mm Realistic Hardware Frame */
  .watch-shell {
    position: relative;
    width: 214px;
    height: 258px;
    padding: 8px;
    border-radius: 48px;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #434752 0%, #1c1e24 40%, #121318 65%, #323640 100%);
    box-shadow:
      0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45),
      inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.22),
      inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  /* Digital Crown */
  .watch-shell::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -7px;
    top: 56px;
    width: 7px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5c616e, #252830 50%, #4b4f5a);
    box-shadow: 1px 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }
  /* Side Button */
  .watch-shell::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -4px;
    top: 112px;
    width: 4px;
    height: 46px;
    border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #484c56, #22242b);
  }

  /* OLED Screen Viewport */
  .watch-screen {
    width: 198px;
    height: 242px;
    border-radius: 40px;
    background: #000000;
    color: #ffffff;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Rounded", "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  .watch-scroll {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    padding: 0 10px 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .watch-scroll > * { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .watch-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  /* WatchOS Status Bar */
  .w-status {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 10px 14px 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    z-index: 3;
  }
  .w-time {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .w-nav-left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .w-back-btn {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #fff;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* Inline SVG icons inside watch */
  .ico {
    width: 1em;
    height: 1em;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: -0.12em;
    fill: currentColor;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* Common watchOS primitives */
  .w-spinner {
    width: 11px;
    height: 11px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.8px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    border-top-color: currentColor;
    display: inline-block;
    animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes pulseDot {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(0.85); }
  }
  @keyframes wavePulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.78); }
    50% { transform: scaleY(1.12); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .w-spinner, .live-dot, .wf-bar { animation: none !important; }
  }

  .truncate {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* ================= TODAY REPLICA ================= */
  .t-room-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    padding: 0 2px;
  }
  .t-mic-circle {
    width: 84px;
    height: 84px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--today-purple);
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 6px auto 2px;
    font-size: 34px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .t-summary {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #9e9ea6;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .t-row {
    background: #1c1c1e;
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 7px 9px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .t-row-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .t-row-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; }
  .t-row-line { font-size: 11px; color: #9e9ea6; }
  .t-chip-needs { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--apple-orange); flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; }
  .t-chip-idle { font-size: 9.5px; color: #9e9ea6; flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; }
  .t-chip-fail { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--apple-red); flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; }

  .t-msg-own { font-size: 12px; color: #9e9ea6; line-height: 1.3; }
  .t-msg-agent-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--today-purple); }
  .t-msg-agent-body { font-size: 12px; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; }
  .t-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #2c2c2e;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-align: center;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 5px;
  }
  .t-btn-accent { background: var(--today-purple); }
  .t-btn-green { background: rgba(50, 215, 75, 0.28); color: #5ef074; }
  .t-btn-red { background: rgba(255, 69, 58, 0.24); color: #ff6961; }

  .t-approval {
    background: rgba(142,142,147,0.2);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  /* ================= OPTION A: LUMINOUS MINDROOM ================= */
  .bg-a-home {
    background:
      radial-gradient(125% 75% at 50% 0%, rgba(44, 134, 155, 0.42) 0%, rgba(12, 42, 54, 0.28) 45%, #000000 85%);
  }
  .bg-a-home.has-urgent {
    background:
      radial-gradient(110% 60% at 85% 0%, rgba(245, 185, 82, 0.24) 0%, transparent 55%),
      radial-gradient(120% 75% at 20% 0%, rgba(44, 134, 155, 0.42) 0%, rgba(10, 32, 42, 0.30) 48%, #000000 85%);
  }
  .bg-a-thread {
    background: radial-gradient(130% 65% at 50% 0%, rgba(36, 114, 134, 0.32) 0%, #050d11 55%, #000000 90%);
  }
  .bg-a-rec {
    background:
      radial-gradient(110% 80% at 50% 38%, rgba(245, 185, 82, 0.24) 0%, rgba(255, 92, 74, 0.16) 42%, #070b0d 82%);
  }

  .a-room-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    max-width: 118px;
  }
  .a-hero-mic {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    padding: 6px 10px 6px 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(69,181,201,0.34), rgba(25,84,102,0.44));
    border: 0.8px solid rgba(112,210,227,0.45);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(17, 108, 128, 0.32);
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .a-hero-orb {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #62cce0, #2a8ea3);
    color: #03151b;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(98, 204, 224, 0.45);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .a-hero-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .a-hero-title { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.15; }
  .a-hero-sub { font-size: 10px; color: rgba(224,244,248,0.82); line-height: 1.2; }
  .a-hero-sub.urgent { color: var(--amber-warm); font-weight: 600; }

  .a-card {
    position: relative;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.075);
    border: 0.6px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.11);
    border-radius: 13px;
    padding: 7px 9px 7px 11px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }
  .a-card::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 6px;
    bottom: 6px;
    width: 3px;
    border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
    background: transparent;
  }
  .a-card.urgent {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,185,82,0.16), rgba(255,255,255,0.06));
    border-color: rgba(245,185,82,0.34);
  }
  .a-card.urgent::before { background: var(--amber); }
  .a-card.running::before { background: var(--teal); }
  .a-card.failed::before { background: var(--apple-red); }

  .a-pill-needs {
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 1.5px 5.5px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(245,185,82,0.22);
    color: var(--amber-warm);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .a-pill-run {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 1.5px 5px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(69,181,201,0.20);
    color: var(--teal-bright);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Option A Thread bubbles */
  .a-bubble-own {
    align-self: flex-end;
    max-width: 88%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11);
    border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    border-radius: 13px 13px 4px 13px;
    padding: 6px 9px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .a-bubble-agent {
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(69,181,201,0.14), rgba(255,255,255,0.06));
    border: 0.6px solid rgba(112,210,227,0.24);
    border-radius: 14px 14px 14px 4px;
    padding: 7px 9px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .a-agent-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
  }
  .a-avatar {
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5cc5d8, #24788c);
    color: #03151b;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 800;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .a-tool-tag {
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 1px 5px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  }
  .a-listen-pill {
    align-self: flex-start;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 3.5px 9px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(69,181,201,0.22);
    border: 0.5px solid rgba(112,210,227,0.35);
    color: var(--teal-bright);
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  /* WatchOS Floating Bottom Bar */
  .w-bottom-bar {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    padding: 16px 12px 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.82) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0.96) 100%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    z-index: 4;
  }
  .w-bar-circle {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
    border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
  .w-bar-pill {
    flex: 1;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 5px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .w-bar-pill.teal {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5cc7da, #2d8fa5);
    color: #03151b;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(69,181,201,0.36);
  }
  .w-bar-pill.gold {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8c668, #d9972c);
    color: #191003;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(245,185,82,0.30);
  }
  .w-bar-pill.red {
    background: var(--apple-red);
    color: #fff;
  }

  /* ================= OPTION B: PAGER FOCUS ================= */
  .bg-b-talk {
    background:
      radial-gradient(95% 75% at 50% 45%, rgba(69, 181, 201, 0.38) 0%, rgba(24, 62, 92, 0.25) 45%, #000000 84%);
  }
  .bg-b-threads {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #101924 0%, #05080c 42%, #000000 100%);
  }
  .b-orb-stage {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 0 12px 10px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .b-orb-wrap {
    position: relative;
    width: 112px;
    height: 112px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .b-ring-2 {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(112,210,227,0.18);
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(69,181,201,0.14), transparent 70%);
  }
  .b-ring-1 {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(112,210,227,0.34);

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-state]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(btn.dataset.state === state.roomState));
    });
    const stateBar = document.getElementById('home-state-controls');
    stateBar.style.display = state.screen === 'home' ? 'flex' : 'none';

    const grid = document.getElementById('watch-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = VARIANTS.map(v => {
      let body = '';
      if (state.screen === 'home') body = renderHome(v.id);
      else if (state.screen === 'thread') body = renderThread(v.id);
      else if (state.screen === 'recording') body = renderRecording(v.id);
      else if (state.screen === 'approval') body = renderApproval(v.id);
      else body = renderWidgets(v.id);

      const bPagerControl = (v.id === 'b' && state.screen === 'home')
        ? `<div class="b-pager-toggle">
             <button type="button" data-bpage="1" class="${state.bPage === 1 ? 'active' : ''}">Page 1: Talk</button>
             <button type="button" data-bpage="2" class="${state.bPage === 2 ? 'active' : ''}">Page 2: Threads</button>
           </div>`
        : '';

      return `
        <div class="variant-col ${v.recommended ? 'recommended' : ''}">
          <div class="variant-head">
            <div class="variant-title-row">
              <span class="variant-title">${v.title}</span>
              <span class="${v.badgeClass}">${v.badge}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="variant-sub">${v.sub}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="watch-shell">
            <div class="watch-screen ${screenClass(v.id)}">${body}</div>
          </div>
          ${bPagerControl}
          <div class="variant-meta">${v.meta}</div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const scr = e.target.closest('[data-screen]');
    if (scr) { state.screen = scr.dataset.screen; render(); return; }
    const st = e.target.closest('[data-state]');
    if (st) { state.roomState = st.dataset.state; render(); return; }
    const bp = e.target.closest('[data-bpage]');
    if (bp) { state.bPage = Number(bp.dataset.bpage); render(); return; }
    const flip = e.target.closest('[data-flip-b]');
    if (flip) { state.bPage = Number(flip.dataset.flipB); render(); return; }
  });

  document.getElementById('pick-form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    if (!window.mindroom || typeof window.mindroom.submit !== 'function') {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    const pick = fd.get('pick') || 'A';
    const data = {
      pick: String(pick),
      brand_palette: fd.get('brand_palette') === 'yes',
      pinned_thread_bar: fd.get('pinned_thread_bar') === 'yes',
      polish_widgets: fd.get('polish_widgets') === 'yes',
      notes: String(fd.get('notes') || '').trim()
    };
    window.mindroom.submit(data, { label: `Apple Watch redesign: Option ${data.pick}` });
  });

  render();
})();
</script>

(() => {

  const VARIANTS = [

    {

    {

    count: Math.min(4, Math.max(2, Number(qs.get('count')) || 3)),
    mode: qs.get('open') === '1' ? 'pinned' : (qs.get('mode') || 'live'),

    // Per-variant MRU order of account indices (order[0] = active)
    orders: {},
  };

  for (const v of VARIANTS) {
    state.orders[v.id] = [0, 1, 2, 3];
  }

  const root = document.getElementById('variants-root');
  const timingSelect = document.getElementById('hold-timing');
  const slowToggle = document.getElementById('slow-toggle');
  const playDemoBtn = document.getElementById('play-demo-btn');

  // Track active stage controllers so Play Demo can drive them
  let stageControllers = [];

  const svgIcon = (name) => {
    if (name === 'menu') {
      return '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/></svg>';

    if (name === 'bell') {
      return '<svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8a6 6 0 1 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"/></svg>';

    if (name === 'search') {
      return '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg>';

  function getActiveAndOthers(variantId) {
    const allowed = state.orders[variantId].filter((i) => i < state.count);

    for (let i = 0; i < state.count; i++) {
      if (!allowed.includes(i)) allowed.push(i);
    }
    state.orders[variantId] = allowed;
    const active = ACCOUNTS[allowed[0]];
    const others = allowed.slice(1).map((i) => ({ index: i, ...ACCOUNTS[i] }));
    return { active, others };

  function switchAccount(variantId, targetIndex) {
    const order = state.orders[variantId].filter((i) => i < state.count);
    const next = [targetIndex, ...order.filter((i) => i !== targetIndex)];
    state.orders[variantId] = next;

    const slow = state.slow ? 3 : 1;
    const val = timingSelect.value;
    if (val === 'hold-350') return 350 * slow;
    return 220 * slow;

  function isInstantDragEnabled() {
    return timingSelect.value === 'drag-or-hold';

      return `

  // Compute radial bubble offsets for Variant A
  function getRadialLayout(surface, count) {
    // Radius generous enough to clear thumb while staying comfortably inside 256px frame
    const r = count === 1 ? 76 : (count === 2 ? 82 : 90);
    // Angles in degrees (0 = right, 90 = down, 180 = left, -90 = up)
    let angles;
    if (surface === 'phone') {
      // Corner is top-right → fan down-left (from 176° left to 94° down)
      if (count === 1) angles = [135];
      else if (count === 2) angles = [160, 110];
      else angles = [174, 135, 96];
    } else {
      // Corner is bottom-left → fan up-right (from -86° up to -4° right)
      if (count === 1) angles = [-45];
      else if (count === 2) angles = [-70, -20];
      else angles = [-84, -45, -6];
    }
    return angles.map((deg) => {
      const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
      return { deg, dx: Math.cos(rad) * r, dy: Math.sin(rad) * r };
    });
  }

  function buildFullMenuHtml(surface, active, others, accountsFirst) {
    const posStyle = surface === 'phone'

    // On rail bottom-left with accountsFirst, put accounts at the BOTTOM with MRU lowest (nearest the corner avatar)
    if (accountsFirst && surface === 'rail') {
      const railAcctRows = [...others].reverse().map((a) => `

    // Standard today AccountMenu order: active header → Settings → others → Add account
    return `

          ${avatarHtml(active, 's30', 'circle')}

  function attachStage(variant, surface, container) {
    const frame = container.querySelector('.app-frame');
    const statusEl = container.querySelector('.stage-status');
    let toastTimer = null;
    let tapMenuOpen = false;
    let holdOpen = false;
    let hotTarget = null; // { kind: 'switch'|'settings'|'add', idx?: number }

    function setStatus(msg) {
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = msg;
    }

    function showToast(msg, acct) {
      const toast = frame.querySelector('.switch-toast');
      if (!toast) return;
      toast.innerHTML = (acct ? avatarHtml(acct, 's30', 'circle').replace('s30', 's30" style="width:18px;height:18px;font-size:8px;background:' + acct.color) : '') + `<span>${msg}</span>`;
      // Cleaner inline badge for toast
      toast.innerHTML = acct
        ? `<span class="av circle" style="width:18px;height:18px;font-size:8.5px;background:${acct.color}">${acct.initials}</span><span>${msg}</span>`
        : `<span>${msg}</span>`;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      clearTimeout(toastTimer);
      toastTimer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 1800);
    }

    function rebuildFrameContent() {
      const { active } = getActiveAndOthers(variant.id);
      frame.innerHTML = `
        ${renderFrameChrome(surface, active)}
        <div class="qm-scrim"></div>
        <div class="qm-layer"></div>
        <div class="hold-hint-pill">${variant.hasHold ? 'Hold & drag avatar' : 'Tap avatar'}</div>
        <div class="switch-toast" role="status"></div>
        <div class="demo-finger"></div>
      `;
      bindInteractions();
      if (state.mode === 'pinned') {
        openPinnedPreview();
      }
    }

    function getOriginCenter() {
      const fr = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
      const tr = frame.querySelector('.avatar-trigger').getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        ox: tr.left - fr.left + tr.width / 2,
        oy: tr.top - fr.top + tr.height / 2,
        fr,
        tr,
      };
    }

    function renderQuickMenuDOM() {
      const layer = frame.querySelector('.qm-layer');
      const { active, others } = getActiveAndOthers(variant.id);
      const { ox, oy } = getOriginCenter();
      layer.classList.remove('interactive-menu');

      if (variant.id === 'A') {
        const coords = getRadialLayout(surface, others.length);
        // Place floating name label in the opposite corner, completely clear of all 1–3 radial bubbles
        const labelStyle = surface === 'phone'
          ? 'bottom: 14px; left: 12px;'
          : 'top: 14px; right: 12px;';
        layer.innerHTML = `
          <svg class="radial-tether" width="100%" height="100%"></svg>
          ${others.map((a, i) => `
            <div class="radial-item glass-panel" data-idx="${a.index}"
              style="left:${ox}px;top:${oy}px;--dx:${coords[i].dx.toFixed(1)}px;--dy:${coords[i].dy.toFixed(1)}px;transition-delay:${i * 22}ms">
              ${avatarHtml(a, 's34', 'circle')}
            </div>
          `).join('')}
          <div class="radial-label glass-panel" style="${labelStyle}">
            <span class="n"></span>
            <span class="u"></span>
            <span class="k">Release to switch</span>
          </div>
        `;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          layer.querySelectorAll('.radial-item').forEach((el) => el.classList.add('open'));
        });
        return { kind: 'A', coords, ox, oy, others };
      }

      if (variant.id === 'B') {
        // Order closest to avatar: on phone top-right MRU is top; on rail bottom-left MRU is bottom!
        const list = surface === 'rail' ? [...others].reverse() : others;
        const posStyle = surface === 'phone'
          ? 'top: 56px; right: 8px; --slide-y: -8px; --nudge-x: -2px;'
          : 'bottom: 10px; left: 72px; --slide-y: 8px; --nudge-x: 2px;';
        layer.innerHTML = `
          <div class="stack-card glass-panel" style="${posStyle}">
            <div class="stack-hdr">Switch account</div>
            ${list.map((a) => `
              <div class="stack-row" data-idx="${a.index}">
                ${avatarHtml(a, 's30', 'circle')}
                <div class="stack-row-text">
                  <span class="stack-row-name">${a.name}</span>
                  <span class="stack-row-id">${a.userId}</span>
                </div>
                <span class="stack-row-arrow">→</span>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        `;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          layer.querySelector('.stack-card')?.classList.add('open');
        });
        return { kind: 'B', ox, oy, others };
      }

      if (variant.id === 'C') {
        const isPhone = surface === 'phone';
        // Phone: expands left along the top bar; Rail: expands upward along the 66px rail
        const barStyle = isPhone
          ? 'top: 4px; right: 4px; transform-origin: right center;'
          : 'bottom: 7px; left: 8px; transform-origin: center bottom;';
        const chipStyle = isPhone
          ? 'top: 56px; right: 10px;'
          : 'bottom: 66px; left: 72px;';
        const shape = isPhone ? 'circle' : 'squircle';
        const avSize = isPhone ? 's30' : 's34';
        layer.innerHTML = `
          <div class="capsule-bar glass-panel ${isPhone ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical'}" style="${barStyle}">
            <div class="capsule-slot origin" data-origin="1">${avatarHtml(active, avSize, shape)}</div>
            ${others.map((a) => `
              <div class="capsule-slot" data-idx="${a.index}">${avatarHtml(a, avSize, shape)}</div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
          <div class="capsule-chip glass-panel" style="${chipStyle}">
            <span class="n"></span>
            <span class="u"></span>
          </div>
        `;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          layer.querySelector('.capsule-bar')?.classList.add('open');
        });
        return { kind: 'C', ox, oy, others };
      }

      if (variant.id === 'D') {
        layer.innerHTML = buildFullMenuHtml(surface, active, others, true);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          layer.querySelector('.full-menu')?.classList.add('open');
        });
        return { kind: 'D', ox, oy, others };
      }

      return null;
    }

    function applyHighlight(ctx, target) {
      hotTarget = target;
      const layer = frame.querySelector('.qm-layer');
      if (!ctx || !layer) return;

      if (ctx.kind === 'A') {
        const items = [...layer.querySelectorAll('.radial-item')];
        const svg = layer.querySelector('.radial-tether');
        const label = layer.querySelector('.radial-label');
        items.forEach((el) => {
          const isHot = target && target.kind === 'switch' && Number(el.dataset.idx) === target.idx;
          el.classList.toggle('hot', !!isHot);
        });
        if (target && target.kind === 'switch') {
          const acct = ACCOUNTS[target.idx];
          const itemIdx = ctx.others.findIndex((o) => o.index === target.idx);
          const c = ctx.coords[itemIdx];
          if (svg && c) {
            svg.innerHTML = `<line x1="${ctx.ox}" y1="${ctx.oy}" x2="${ctx.ox + c.dx * 1.04}" y2="${ctx.oy + c.dy * 1.04}" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 4" stroke-opacity="0.7" />`;
          }
          if (label) {
            label.querySelector('.n').textContent = acct.name;
            label.querySelector('.u').textContent = acct.userId;
            label.classList.add('show');
          }
          setStatus(`→ ${acct.name}`);
        } else {
          if (svg) svg.innerHTML = '';
          if (label) label.classList.remove('show');
          setStatus('Slide to an account');
        }
        return;
      }

      if (ctx.kind === 'B') {
        layer.querySelectorAll('.stack-row').forEach((el) => {
          const isHot = target && target.kind === 'switch' && Number(el.dataset.idx) === target.idx;
          el.classList.toggle('hot', !!isHot);
        });
        setStatus(target ? `→ ${ACCOUNTS[target.idx].name}` : 'Slide over an account');
        return;
      }

      if (ctx.kind === 'C') {
        const chip = layer.querySelector('.capsule-chip');
        layer.querySelectorAll('.capsule-slot[data-idx]').forEach((el) => {
          const isHot = target && target.kind === 'switch' && Number(el.dataset.idx) === target.idx;
          el.classList.toggle('hot', !!isHot);
        });
        if (target && target.kind === 'switch') {
          const acct = ACCOUNTS[target.idx];
          if (chip) {
            chip.querySelector('.n').textContent = acct.name;
            chip.querySelector('.u').textContent = acct.userId;
            chip.classList.add('show');
          }
          setStatus(`→ ${acct.name}`);
        } else {
          if (chip) chip.classList.remove('show');
          setStatus(surface === 'phone' ? 'Slide left to pick' : 'Slide up to pick');
        }
        return;
      }

      if (ctx.kind === 'D') {
        layer.querySelectorAll('.menu-row').forEach((el) => {
          const isHot = target && (
            (target.kind === 'switch' && el.dataset.action === 'switch' && Number(el.dataset.idx) === target.idx) ||
            (target.kind !== 'switch' && el.dataset.action === target.kind)
          );
          el.classList.toggle('hot', !!isHot);
        });
        if (target?.kind === 'switch') setStatus(`→ ${ACCOUNTS[target.idx].name}`);
        else if (target?.kind === 'settings') setStatus('→ Settings');
        else if (target?.kind === 'add') setStatus('→ Add account');
        else setStatus('Slide to pick, or release on avatar to keep open');
      }
    }

    function hitTest(ctx, clientX, clientY) {
      if (!ctx) return null;
      const fr = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = clientX - fr.left;
      const py = clientY - fr.top;
      const layer = frame.querySelector('.qm-layer');

      if (ctx.kind === 'A') {
        const vx = px - ctx.ox;
        const vy = py - ctx.oy;
        const dist = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
        if (dist < 26 || dist > 195) return null;
        const pointerDeg = (Math.atan2(vy, vx) * 180) / Math.PI;
        let best = null;
        let bestDiff = 42; // angular sector tolerance in degrees
        ctx.coords.forEach((c, i) => {
          let diff = Math.abs(pointerDeg - c.deg);
          if (diff > 180) diff = 360 - diff;
          if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            best = { kind: 'switch', idx: ctx.others[i].index };
          }
        });
        return best;
      }

      if (ctx.kind === 'B') {
        // Dead zone over origin avatar cancels
        if (Math.hypot(px - ctx.ox, py - ctx.oy) < 22) return null;
        const rows = [...layer.querySelectorAll('.stack-row')];
        for (const row of rows) {
          const r = row.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (clientY >= r.top - 4 && clientY <= r.bottom + 4 && clientX >= r.left - 32 && clientX <= r.right + 32) {
            return { kind: 'switch', idx: Number(row.dataset.idx) };
          }
        }
        return null;
      }

      if (ctx.kind === 'C') {
        if (Math.hypot(px - ctx.ox, py - ctx.oy) < 20) return null;
        const slots = [...layer.querySelectorAll('.capsule-slot[data-idx]')];
        let best = null;
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        for (const slot of slots) {
          const r = slot.getBoundingClientRect();
          const cx = (r.left + r.right) / 2;
          const cy = (r.top + r.bottom) / 2;
          if (surface === 'phone') {
            // Generous vertical tolerance below the top bar so thumb doesn't hide avatars
            if (Math.abs(clientY - cy) <= 72 && Math.abs(clientX - cx) <= 26) {
              const d = Math.abs(clientX - cx);
              if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = { kind: 'switch', idx: Number(slot.dataset.idx) }; }
            }
          } else {
            // Generous horizontal tolerance right of the rail
            if (Math.abs(clientX - cx) <= 72 && Math.abs(clientY - cy) <= 26) {
              const d = Math.abs(clientY - cy);
              if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = { kind: 'switch', idx: Number(slot.dataset.idx) }; }
            }
          }
        }
        return best;
      }

      if (ctx.kind === 'D') {
        const rows = [...layer.querySelectorAll('.menu-row')];
        for (const row of rows) {
          const r = row.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (clientY >= r.top && clientY <= r.bottom && clientX >= r.left - 18 && clientX <= r.right + 18) {
            const action = row.dataset.action;
            if (action === 'switch') return { kind: 'switch', idx: Number(row.dataset.idx) };
            return { kind: action };
          }
        }
        return null;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function closeAllOverlays() {
      holdOpen = false;
      tapMenuOpen = false;
      hotTarget = null;
      frame.classList.remove('qm-open');
      const trig = frame.querySelector('.avatar-trigger');
      if (trig) trig.classList.remove('pressing', 'engaged');
      const layer = frame.querySelector('.qm-layer');
      if (layer) {
        layer.innerHTML = '';
        layer.classList.remove('interactive-menu');
      }
      setStatus(variant.hasHold ? 'Ready · hold avatar' : 'Ready · tap avatar');
    }

    function openTapMenu(accountsFirst = false) {
      closeAllOverlays();
      tapMenuOpen = true;
      frame.classList.add('qm-open');
      const layer = frame.querySelector('.qm-layer');
      const { active, others } = getActiveAndOthers(variant.id);
      layer.classList.add('interactive-menu');
      layer.innerHTML = buildFullMenuHtml(surface, active, others, accountsFirst);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => layer.querySelector('.full-menu')?.classList.add('open'));
      setStatus(variant.hasHold ? 'Full menu (tap)' : 'AccountMenu open');

      layer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const row = e.target.closest('.menu-row');
        if (!row) {
          closeAllOverlays();
          return;
        }
        const action = row.dataset.action;
        if (action === 'switch') {
          const idx = Number(row.dataset.idx);
          switchAccount(variant.id, idx);
          closeAllOverlays();
          rerenderVariantPair(variant.id, ACCOUNTS[idx]);
        } else if (action === 'settings') {
          closeAllOverlays();
          showToast('Opened Settings');
        } else if (action === 'add') {
          closeAllOverlays();
          showToast('Opened Add Account');
        }
      }, { once: true });
    }

    function openPinnedPreview() {
      if (!variant.hasHold) {
        openTapMenu(false);
        return;
      }
      frame.classList.add('qm-open');
      const trig = frame.querySelector('.avatar-trigger');
      trig?.classList.add('engaged');
      const ctx = renderQuickMenuDOM();
      const { others } = getActiveAndOthers(variant.id);
      // Highlight MRU other account so Bas immediately sees the active swipe state
      if (others[0]) {
        applyHighlight(ctx, { kind: 'switch', idx: others[0].index });
      }
    }

    function bindInteractions() {
      const trig = frame.querySelector('.avatar-trigger');
      if (!trig) return;

      let pressTimer = null;
      let startX = 0;
      let startY = 0;
      let activeCtx = null;
      let movedTooFar = false;

      trig.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0 || state.mode === 'pinned') return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (tapMenuOpen) {
          closeAllOverlays();
          return;
        }
        if (!variant.hasHold) {
          openTapMenu(false);
          return;
        }
        trig.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        startX = e.clientX;
        startY = e.clientY;
        movedTooFar = false;
        holdOpen = false;
        activeCtx = null;
        trig.classList.add('pressing');
        setStatus('Hold…');

        const activateHold = () => {
          clearTimeout(pressTimer);
          pressTimer = null;
          if (holdOpen) return;
          holdOpen = true;
          trig.classList.remove('pressing');
          trig.classList.add('engaged');
          frame.classList.add('qm-open');
          activeCtx = renderQuickMenuDOM();
          applyHighlight(activeCtx, null);
        };

        pressTimer = setTimeout(activateHold, getHoldMs());
        trig._activateHold = activateHold;
      });

      trig.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (!pressTimer && !holdOpen) return;
        const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - startX, e.clientY - startY);
        if (!holdOpen) {
          if (dist > 12) {
            if (isInstantDragEnabled() && trig._activateHold) {
              trig._activateHold();
            } else {
              clearTimeout(pressTimer);
              pressTimer = null;
              movedTooFar = true;
              trig.classList.remove('pressing');
              setStatus('Cancelled');
            }
          }
          return;
        }
        const hit = hitTest(activeCtx, e.clientX, e.clientY);
        applyHighlight(activeCtx, hit);
      });

      const finishPointer = (e, cancelled) => {
        clearTimeout(pressTimer);
        pressTimer = null;
        trig.classList.remove('pressing');

        if (!holdOpen) {
          if (!cancelled && !movedTooFar && variant.hasHold && state.mode !== 'pinned') {
            // Short tap → open normal AccountMenu
            openTapMenu(false);
          }
          return;
        }

        const picked = cancelled ? null : hotTarget;
        // Variant D ergonomic grace: lifting right on the avatar leaves the menu open
        if (!cancelled && variant.id === 'D' && !picked) {
          const { ox, oy, fr } = getOriginCenter();
          if (Math.hypot((e.clientX - fr.left) - ox, (e.clientY - fr.top) - oy) < 28) {
            openTapMenu(true);
            return;
          }
        }

        closeAllOverlays();
        if (picked?.kind === 'switch') {
          switchAccount(variant.id, picked.idx);
          rerenderVariantPair(variant.id, ACCOUNTS[picked.idx]);
        } else if (picked?.kind === 'settings') {
          showToast('Opened Settings');
        } else if (picked?.kind === 'add') {
          showToast('Opened Add Account');
        } else {
          setStatus('Cancelled');
        }
      };

      trig.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => finishPointer(e, false));
      trig.addEventListener('pointercancel', (e) => finishPointer(e, true));
    }

    // Programmatic animated demo for this stage
    async function playDemo() {
      if (!variant.hasHold || state.mode === 'pinned') return;
      const slow = state.slow ? 3 : 1;
      const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
      const finger = frame.querySelector('.demo-finger');
      const trig = frame.querySelector('.avatar-trigger');
      if (!finger || !trig) return;

      closeAllOverlays();
      const { ox, oy, fr } = getOriginCenter();
      const { others } = getActiveAndOthers(variant.id);
      if (!others.length) return;

      // Step 1: land finger on avatar
      finger.style.transition = 'opacity 120ms ease';
      finger.style.left = `${ox}px`;
      finger.style.top = `${oy}px`;
      finger.classList.add('active');
      trig.classList.add('pressing');
      setStatus('Holding…');
      await wait(260 * slow);

      // Step 2: open quick menu
      trig.classList.remove('pressing');
      trig.classList.add('engaged');
      frame.classList.add('qm-open');
      const ctx = renderQuickMenuDOM();
      applyHighlight(ctx, null);
      await wait(240 * slow);

      // Step 3: compute destination point (MRU other account)
      let tx = ox;
      let ty = oy;
      if (ctx.kind === 'A') {
        tx = ox + ctx.coords[0].dx;
        ty = oy + ctx.coords[0].dy;
      } else {
        const targetSel = ctx.kind === 'B'
          ? `.stack-row[data-idx="${others[0].index}"]`
          : ctx.kind === 'C'
            ? `.capsule-slot[data-idx="${others[0].index}"]`
            : `.menu-row[data-idx="${others[0].index}"]`;
        const el = frame.querySelector(targetSel);
        if (el) {
          const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          tx = r.left - fr.left + r.width / 2;
          ty = r.top - fr.top + r.height / 2;
        }
      }

      // Animate ghost finger across to target
      finger.style.transition = `left ${360 * slow}ms var(--ease-std), top ${360 * slow}ms var(--ease-std), opacity 120ms ease`;
      finger.style.left = `${tx}px`;
      finger.style.top = `${ty}px`;
      await wait(240 * slow);
      applyHighlight(ctx, { kind: 'switch', idx: others[0].index });
      await wait(440 * slow);

      // Step 4: lift & switch
      finger.classList.remove('active');
      const chosen = others[0];
      closeAllOverlays();
      switchAccount(variant.id, chosen.index);
      rebuildFrameContent();
      showToast(`Switched to ${chosen.name}`, chosen);
    }

    rebuildFrameContent();

    return {
      variantId: variant.id,
      surface,
      rebuild: rebuildFrameContent,
      showToast,
      playDemo,
    };
  }

  function rerenderVariantPair(variantId, switchedAcct) {
    for (const ctrl of stageControllers) {
      if (ctrl.variantId === variantId) {
        ctrl.rebuild();
        if (switchedAcct) ctrl.showToast(`Switched to ${switchedAcct.name}`, switchedAcct);
      }
    }
  }

  function renderAll() {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--slow', state.slow ? '3' : '1');
    stageControllers = [];
    const list = state.filterVariant
      ? VARIANTS.filter((v) => v.id === state.filterVariant)
      : VARIANTS;

    const surfaces = state.surface === 'both' ? ['phone', 'rail'] : [state.surface];

    root.innerHTML = '';
    for (const v of list) {
      const card = document.createElement('section');
      card.className = 'variant-card';
      card.dataset.variant = v.id;
      const pickedVal = document.querySelector('input[name="pick"]:checked')?.value;
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="variant-head">
          <div class="variant-head-top">
            <div class="variant-title">
              <span>${v.title}</span>
              <span class="badge ${v.rec ? 'rec' : ''}">${v.badge}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="variant-meta">
              <span class="badge">${v.loc}</span>
              ${v.hasHold ? `<button type="button" class="pick-mini ${pickedVal === v.id ? 'selected' : ''}" data-pick="${v.id}">Pick ${v.id}</button>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="variant-desc">${v.desc}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stages" data-surface="${state.surface}">
          ${surfaces.map((s) => `
            <div class="stage-wrap" data-stage="${s}">
              <div class="stage-caption">
                <span>${s === 'phone' ? 'Phone · top-right avatar' : 'Desktop / drawer · bottom-left rail'}</span>
                <span class="stage-status">${v.hasHold ? 'Ready · hold avatar' : 'Ready · tap avatar'}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="app-frame"></div>
            </div>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
      root.appendChild(card);

      card.querySelectorAll('.stage-wrap').forEach((wrap) => {
        stageControllers.push(attachStage(v, wrap.dataset.stage, wrap));
      });
    }

    // Wire mini Pick buttons to the bottom form
    root.querySelectorAll('.pick-mini').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const val = btn.dataset.pick;
        const radio = document.querySelector(`input[name="pick"][value="${val}"]`);
        if (radio) {
          radio.checked = true;
          syncPickBadges();
          document.getElementById('pick-form').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function syncPickBadges() {
    const val = document.querySelector('input[name="pick"]:checked')?.value;
    root.querySelectorAll('.pick-mini').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.classList.toggle('selected', btn.dataset.pick === val);
    });
  }

  // Wire toolbar controls
  function bindSeg(segId, prop, transform = (x) => x) {
    const seg = document.getElementById(segId);
    seg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const raw = btn.dataset[prop] ?? btn.dataset.surface ?? btn.dataset.count ?? btn.dataset.mode;
        state[prop] = transform(raw);
        seg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b === btn)));
        renderAll();
      });
    });
  }

  // Initialize pressed states to match initial state
  document.querySelectorAll('#surface-seg button').forEach((b) =>
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.surface === state.surface))
  );
  document.querySelectorAll('#count-seg button').forEach((b) =>
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(Number(b.dataset.count) === state.count))
  );
  document.querySelectorAll('#mode-seg button').forEach((b) =>
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.mode === state.mode))
  );
  slowToggle.checked = state.slow;

  bindSeg('surface-seg', 'surface');
  bindSeg('count-seg', 'count', Number);
  bindSeg('mode-seg', 'mode');

  slowToggle.addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.slow = slowToggle.checked;
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--slow', state.slow ? '3' : '1');
  });

  playDemoBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (state.mode === 'pinned') {
      state.mode = 'live';
      document.querySelectorAll('#mode-seg button').forEach((b) =>
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.mode === 'live'))
      );
      renderAll();
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 80));
    }
    playDemoBtn.disabled = true;
    playDemoBtn.textContent = 'Playing…';
    try {
      await Promise.all(stageControllers.map((c) => c.playDemo()));
    } finally {
      playDemoBtn.disabled = false;
      playDemoBtn.textContent = '▶ Play demo';
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="pick"]').forEach((r) =>
    r.addEventListener('change', syncPickBadges)
  );

  // Standalone fallback submit handler when testing outside Chat
  if (!inChat) {
    document.getElementById('pick-form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
      const data = Object.fromEntries(fd.entries());
      const note = document.querySelector('.form-note');
      if (note) note.textContent = `Preview pick recorded: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`;
    });
  }

  renderAll();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
